changelog:
- Initial release of "Video Outpainting — Pro Pack on RunComfy".
- Enables spatial extension of video canvas using the runcomfy CLI, including aspect ratio conversion (e.g., 9:16 to 16:9) and environment generation beyond original frames.
- Routes default workflow through Wan 2-7 Edit-Video for prompt-driven outpainting; suggests ComfyUI workflows for cases requiring high-quality seamless extension.
- Supports trigger phrases like "video outpaint", "expand video frame", and "aspect ratio change".
- Provides clear CLI instructions and security guidelines for safe integration.
display_name: Video Outpainting — Pro Pack on RunComfy
summary: Video outpainting on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI — extend the spatial canvas of a video, change aspect ratio (9:16 vertical to 16:9 horizontal or vice versa), add environment beyond the original frame while preserving the central action. Routes prompt-shaped spatial extension through Wan 2-7 edit-video and points the agent at dedicated ComfyUI outpaint workflows when seam quality matters for hero delivery. Triggers on "video outpaint", "video outpainting", "extend video canvas", "expand video frame", "uncrop video", "aspect ratio change", "vertical to horizontal video", "16:9 from 9:16", "TikTok to YouTube", or any explicit ask to extend a video spatially beyond its original frame.
